notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey racers,  



The underground race organizers have updated some of the rules in the demo with new music and sound effects, updated UI elements and menus, and more.  


Here are the full patch notes
 Updated UI elements and menus

 New music and sound effects

 Added a new bug reporting system

 Added support for Bluetooth input

 Various bugfixes


Also I want to let you know that we have changed how to report bugs for Airframe Ultra. You’ll be able to report bugs here which will be sent up to the developers directly! The new bug reporting system in game will also lead to this link as well!
https://bugs.akuparagames.com/airframe-ultra/bugs 


-riv otter
